items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And I didn't know Mitchell real well, but, you know, I knew him casually.

ctx.x: Did you know any of the other guys on the date?
Yeah, well, I knew Omer Simeon. And Shirley Clay, trumpet player. And I didn't know Mitchell real well, but, you know, I knew him casually.
